Maya Singh (PixelAI): Hey CS, onboarding hit an issue. After ~70s our mobile SDK starts returning 403 then a burst of 429s. Error shows 'token_invalid' then 'quota_exceeded: per_key'. Demo on Friday—need quick triage.
Priya Khatri: Thanks Maya. Which mobile SDK + version? Are you proxying traffic or calling Redwood directly?
Maya Singh (PixelAI): react-native sdk v1.4.2 behind our app gateway. We mint short tokens TTL=100s, refresh at 20s before expiry, but we also keep old token for 40s to avoid mid-stream failures.
Noah Rivera: Keeping old token that long is suspicious. If gateway multiplexes requests, you can end up with tokenA and tokenB hitting auth checks within a tiny window, which counts towards per_key quotas.
Maya Singh (PixelAI): Repro snippet from our logs: ```
# t=0 stream start -> 200
# t=85 token swap on client -> 403 {"error":"token_invalid"}
# immediate retry flood -> 429 {"error":"quota_exceeded","quota":"per_key"}
```
Priya Khatri: Two quick actions: 1) try lowering old token keep to <=5s for a short test, 2) increase retry backoff (>=150ms) to avoid tight retry bursts. We can open a temp relax on per-key quota while you validate.
Maya Singh (PixelAI): Ok will try oldKeep=3s and backoff 200ms now. Concern: will streams be interrupted?
Noah Rivera: For long-lived streaming, prefer using the same token for the entire stream lifecycle and only rotate on new connections. That avoids mid-stream swaps. Short keep window is safe for standard request traffic.
CS Bot: Ticket created: CS-8022 0min TTL18022; labels: onboarding, auth, rate-quota. Temporary per-key relaxation available until 1767658000.
Maya Singh (PixelAI): Quick test result: 10 min with modest load, no 403/429. Looks stable. Will ramp and report.
Priya Khatri: Thanks Maya. If stable, we'll update onboarding docs to include guidance: "avoid >10s old-token retention behind multiplexing proxies" and add reproduce CLI.
Noah Rivera: I'll add a short reproduce script to the playbook and note clock sync checks (NTP) for proxies.
Maya Singh (PixelAI): Great, demo safe for now. Will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
